paragraphs.text: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the Backend Engineer — Distributed Systems role. Your platform group’s focus on building and operating services with pragmatic engineering and measurable impact aligns with how I approach backend work. At Northwind Data, I worked on APIs where p95 latency dropped 40% between 2019 and 2024, with traffic reaching 2M requests/day across 3 regions, and I am eager to bring that same focus on measurable outcomes to your team.

Your need for Go-based APIs backed by PostgreSQL matches my background. Between 2016 and 2019, I built billing services in Go handling $12M annual volume. I also shipped a PostgreSQL schema-automation tool adopted by 5 teams. This work involved relational data modeling and query performance, areas I understand are central to your API and observability goals.

I led production Kubernetes work that moved 40+ services with zero downtime, an effort that reinforced my focus on reliability and observability in distributed systems. Your emphasis on clear written communication and design review resonates with how I collaborate: explaining trade-offs plainly and helping teammates ship dependable services. Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background can support your platform group.
